hist-pre-01-c3.text: Sarah Hake, Jeffrey Ross-Ibarra (2015). The Natural History of Model Organisms: Genetic, evolutionary and plant breeding insights from the domestication of maize. eLife 4:e05861.
hist-pre-01-c3.quote: The natural history of maize began nine thousand years ago
hist-pre-01-c3.claim: Maize (corn) was domesticated from teosinte in Mexico about 9000 BP.
